name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost) is too weak for “do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.” It only forbids key_lost before the first door_open; after the door is opened and then closed, it allows key_lost while the door is closed. Use a rule that also forbids key_lost whenever door_open is false, while retaining the requirement that the box is picked up.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Absence(key_lost) is too broad. The task forbids dropping the key while the door is closed only until the door has been opened once; it allows dropping the key while the door is closed afterward. Replace it with hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost), which ends the ban once the door has opened.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires picking up the box. Precedence(door_open, key_lost) forbids losing the key before the door has opened, matching the task’s “until the door has been opened once” condition.

texts: Pick up the mission's box in the other room.
Do not lose the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.
